chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Yahya ibn al-Mubarak, from Abdullah ibn Jabala, from Sama'ah, from Abu Baseer and Is'haq ibn Ammar,

from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And most of them do not believe in Allah except they are associating others (with Him)' [12:106]. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He obeys the Satan from where he does not even know, so he associates (commits shirk).'

key_terms.مُشْرِكُونَ: Those who associate partners with God (polytheists)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'except they are associating others' in Surah Yusuf 12:106 according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the verse by defining this specific form of shirk as unconscious obedience to Satan, where individuals associate him with God in domains they are unaware of. This interpretation highlights the subtle, often hidden nature of polytheism in Shia theology, distinguishing it from explicit idolatry by focusing on the internal state of unawareness (ghaflah) during acts of devotion or obedience.
